Name: Runeterra Valley
Author: SnoringSnorr
Description:
I randomly, one day, had fun in the idea of trying to assign certain champions from League of Legends to Stardew Valley characters and just ended up wanting to create a whole mod for this, so here we are.

This is my first mod I am ever releasing and it is as simple as it sounds... replacing all the sprites and names of most Stardew Valley NPCs with champions from League of Legends, that I figured would fit their personality really nicely.

I want to repeat again that this is a purely visual mod. It only replaces sprites, portraits and names, besides that the game is fully vanilla with this mod installed. No added dialogue, events... etc.

The mod is a simple content patcher pack, so it only requires SMAPI and... well.. Content Patcher. Which also means that it hopefully should not clash much with other mods. But it obviously will not change any added characters from other mods.
[b]It also will NOT change names in any Dialogue added from other mods, the changed names only work for Vanilla Dialogue so far.[/b]

All spritework I have done by myself, obviously using the base sprites and portraits as inspiration for a lot of characters.
The creators of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] also were nice enough to let me use some of their spritework as inspiration. Thank you so much!

VERY, VERY big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/82887233]ApollyonSV[/url]﻿ and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url] mod. They made it possible to also have name and gender changes of the characters possible in Dialogue as well, by letting me use the code of their mod. Thank you so much! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]
[/url]
I hope that you will enjoy this mod and please let me know if you find any visual errors, bugs or glitches! Im happy with any kind of feedback!

If you are interested in more pixel art from me, you can follow my twitter [url=https://twitter.com/SnoringSnorr]@SnoringSnorr[/url]﻿ (im also planning to take commissions soon)
